text:
The Red Wings come back from four days off still living inside the same story. Dylan Larkin asked for a trade in the summer, lost the captaincy in September, left the team on Oct. 29 and has been suspended without pay since. The offers are real (the Detroit Free Press reported this week that Detroit has them, including Minnesota's package built around Danila Yurov and first-round picks), but the Red Wings want an established scorer, preferably a center, and they are willing to wait. Meanwhile someone has to play his minutes. Andrew Copp has taken his spot beside Lucas Raymond and Viktor Arvidsson and is up to 19:21 a night, and Emmitt Finnie has moved onto the first power-play unit.

The waiting has not been kind. Detroit is 1-4-0 in its last five with just 41% of the expected goals (the quality of chances) and did not win the chance battle in any of them. The one win was Daniil Tarasov's 31-save shutout in Tampa. Tarasov has been the best thing about this month: a .931 save rate and +9.6 goals saved above expected, starting again while John Gibson's struggles fill the Detroit headlines.

Boston arrives on the second night of a back-to-back, a night after Darcy Kuemper shut them out 3-0. The Bruins are winless in three and outscored 14-4, but the chances tell a gentler story: they had 53% of the expected goals in that stretch and won the chance battle in four of their last five. Over the season it runs the other way, with finishing and Jeremy Swayman (+6.0 saves above expected) carrying results ahead of the process. They are still without James Hagens, and Pavel Zacha's name keeps turning up in trade columns.

Our numbers see it close, 3.01 expected goals for Detroit to 2.80 for Boston. The race gives it weight: the Bruins sit at 27 points with a 73% playoff chance, the Red Wings at 19 and 21%. Arvidsson faces his old team without a goal in eight games on 2.5 expected goals, and Morgan Geekie has seven points in four career games against Detroit.
headline: The Red Wings wait on Larkin, and Tarasov holds the fort
